summary.text: Doris Hohensee is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lives in Nashua, previously served on the Nashua Board of Education, and chairs a political action committee focused on education.

paragraphs.text: Doris Hohensee lives in Nashua, New Hampshire, and earned a B.A. in mathematics from the College of Mount Saint Vincent in 1976.

Her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as education activist, and says she chairs New Hampshire Families for Education, which describes itself as a volunteer-run, non-partisan political action committee dedicated to preserving local control and advocating for increased family involvement in education.
Hohensee ran unopposed for an at-large seat on the Nashua Board of Education in 2015 and assumed office that year.
She was the Republican nominee for the New Hampshire House in Hillsborough 30 in 2012, and for the state Senate in District 13 in 2014, losing both general elections.
She was on the general election ballot for the state House again in 2020 (Hillsborough 30) and 2024 (Hillsborough 6), and advanced from the Republican primary for Hillsborough 6 on September 8, 2026.
